svg.title: From individual numbers to a supplied summary
svg.desc: A real 64-element trajectory from the stochastic sorting simulator. A disturbed array recovers through local compare-and-swap operations. One successful and one failed attempt are shown from the first even-edge phase. Full states retain element values and exchange probabilities; the supplied summary retains three global and twenty-four regional numbers.
svg.text: Ordered: each number is in its own position
Close-up: two attempts in the first half-round
What the predictor receives at the start
